name: darkmoon
description: Drive a self-hosted Darkmoon Pro instance from an MCP client: start an autonomous AI pentest run against an authorized target, poll its status, list campaigns and read findings that require human review, with severity statistics. Requires the Darkmoon Pro Dashboard API (the open source engine and CLI alone are not enough).

DARKMOON_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of your self-hosted Darkmoon Pro Dashboard API (there is no public hosted endpoint)

DARKMOON_TOKEN.description: Pre-issued JWT, used instead of username and password

tools.name: run_pentest
tools.description: Start an autonomous pentest against one authorized target and return the run_id

tools.name: get_run_status
tools.description: Report running, completed, error or unknown for a run, from its run log

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns visible to the dashboard user (read only)

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description: Vulnerabilities and severity statistics for a campaign (read only)

npm.description: Run the published npm package over stdio against your own Darkmoon Pro instance

examples.title: Review latest findings
examples.description: Summarize what the last campaign found
examples.prompt: List my Darkmoon campaigns and summarize the critical and high findings of the latest completed one.

examples.title: Start a run on a staging target
examples.description: Launch an autonomous pentest against a system you are authorized to test
examples.prompt: Start a Darkmoon pentest against staging.example.com, which I am authorized to test, and tell me the run_id.
